title: Splitting a String Into Descending Consecutive Values
goal: Split a digit string into at least two descending consecutive numeric values.
strategy: Choose a first chunk and recursively try following chunks equal to previous minus one. Leading zeros are allowed; arbitrary-precision integers preserve long chunk values.
